history.name: Placing a new area, not appending it
history.description: A new area of the product is added relative to an existing one — before it or after it — because that list is the reading order of every document. An area therefore arrives where a reader should meet it rather than at the end by default.
history.dev_notes: `ledger categories add "Name" [--after X | --before Y]`; `ledger categories` lists the areas with a count of what's filed in each.
